description.value: Continental Seafood Restaurant is a long-established Cantonese restaurant in Richmond with over 20 years of operation, housed in a spacious 12,000 sq ft dining room capable of hosting events for up to 600 guests. The menu spans traditional dim sum served from trolley carts, seafood, and rice and noodle dishes from multiple Chinese provinces, with set dinners popular for groups. Touring cyclists stopping here will find a full-service restaurant with takeout service and a lively atmosphere including nightly live entertainment and a dance floor.

The website explicitly advertises takeout and mentions vegetarian dishes under Chinese Dishes.
